reviews.title: Works well even mixed with other RAM
reviews.comment: So my new RAM just arrived, a kit of 8GB x2 from Puskill. I already had a 16GB kit from Gigastone GamePro running at 3600. At first, when I installed the new RAM, my PC didn’t even turn on, so it was kind of complicated. I had to move the sticks around a lot until it finally worked. In the end, I put the Puskill in slots 1 and 2, and the old Gigastone in slots 3 and 4. Now I have 32GB total and it’s running stable at 3200. I had to tweak some things in the BIOS manually, but I didn’t really use XMP, I just adjusted it myself. Before this, when I had my browser open with a lot of tabs and tried to game at the same time, my CPU was almost at 100% and the temperatures were really high. Now I’m using around 18GB of RAM in the same situation and my PC is way smoother and cooler, so RAM was clearly a big bottleneck for me. With import costs I paid around $130 USD for this, and honestly I think it was worth it to have a faster and more stable PC. My setup now is: MSI B550 Pro micro atx motherboard, Ryzen 7 5700G, ASUS Prime RTX 5070, and 8GB x2 Gigastone GamePro + 8GB x2 Puskill RAM

Looks are just a sticker on the mem  sticks but I'm not some kid  who has to go for flashing lights and such,quality seems very stable so far but will update if any issues

reviews.title: Works Great, average performing and simple looking budget memory.
reviews.comment: No issues at all with A520 Mobo and R5 5500 CPU. Runs at rated 3200Mhz speed once XMP 2.0 is set in in the bios. i removed the stickers very easily and they are a nice almost black color and could be modified with heatsinks to look more like "Gaming" ram if that is your thing.

reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.comment: Good quality, low profile, the size was perfect to fit in my ITX build together with the Noctua NH-L12S CPU cooler. In the bios i enabled the XMP profile option and they work at 3200MHZ without problems. Very happy with this.
